name: Warden Book House
description: Established in 1952, Warden Book House is a timeless destination for bibliophiles and spiritual seekers in Mumbai. This iconic bookshop, a cornerstone of the Breach Candy community, offers an extensive and diverse collection of books, catering to a wide range of interests. As one of India's premier destinations for spiritual and divination tools, they feature an exceptional selection of card decks, kits, and accessories specifically curated for healers, light workers, and practitioners. Immerse yourself in a world of knowledge and inspiration at Warden Book House.

owner_posts.post_text:
Astrology is more than just the 12 signs of the zodiac—it's a layered, multi-faceted tool for understanding ourselves & others. In this fascinating guide, you can discover what your sun sign says about you, who you are most compatible with romantically, & how you can progress in life with insights from the heavens above. More advanced ideas regarding aspects such as Mercury Retrograde, Moon Signs & other astrological terms are explained fully & permit the reader to begin their journey into this lifelong passion.

• Descriptions of all 12 signs
• Controversies about whether there is a 13th sign addressed
• Moon signs & their significance

This book is a wonderful companion for anyone wanting to align their life with the magic of the stars.

• Includes 36 full-colour cards featuring sacred icon-style paintings of threatened & endangered species & instructions for using this deck in a group setting
• Portrays the unique charism of each species, the challenges it faces, & how it affects the greater biological community & human health
• Teaches Visio Divina, or sacred seeing, an ancient form of prayer & meditation that evokes intuitive knowing & inspires meaningful action

Exploring the richness & necessity of biodiversity, this deck of 36 full-colour cards features the work of world-renowned artist Angela Manno & reveals how the loss of biodiversity is leading to the warming of our planet. She presents each threatened species in a traditionally religious form—the icon—to illustrate its true significance.

Rich with insights from geologian Thomas Berry & other ecological elders, the guidebook reveals the preciousness of each organism, specific challenges to its existence, & its effect on the greater biological community & human health.

Uniquely supported by QR codes leading to the websites of conservation organisations working to protect each species & its habitat, this deck inspires contemplation, empathy, & meaningful action to enact personal & planetary healing.

Many people feel called to some greater purpose in life but struggle to discover what that purpose is or even where to begin. Others know they have a gift but are unclear how to develop or articulate that gift. The 11 Spiritual Roles of the Soul, by celebrated author & channel Sara Landon, offers readers a profound & life-changing perspective on why we are here on Earth at this time.

In this book, The Council—an energetic presence of non-physical beings—reveals the 11 spiritual roles of the soul: healer, messenger, seer, transformer, dreamer, visualizer, wayshower, connector, uplifter, coder, & guide. 

After understanding their spiritual role, readers will learn:
• How the 11 spiritual roles relate to their life’s purpose
• How to use their spiritual gifts to enhance & expand every area of their lives
• Why stepping into their spiritual role right now is so important
• How they fit into the Great Awakening of humanity occurring at this time
• Daily practices for embodying their spiritual roles

By aligning with their spiritual roles, individuals can uncover their true purpose, develop confidence in their unique gifts, & navigate their path with renewed clarity & joy.

In his million-copy bestseller, THE 80/20 PRINCIPLE, Richard Koch showed readers how to take advantage of the simple fact that 80% of your results come from 20% of your efforts. In 80/20 BELIEFS, he shows how just a few core beliefs - often unconscious yet profoundly influential - shape our lives, happiness & success.

By identifying & examining the 'toxic' beliefs that cause unnecessary stress & shaping them into good beliefs that foster resilience & joy, we can enjoy a life of greater fulfilment.

“Time is money,” as the saying goes, but most of us never feel we have enough of either. In Master Your Time, Master Your Life, internationally acclaimed productivity expert & bestselling author Brian Tracy presents a brilliant new approach to time management that will help you gain control of your time & accomplish far more, faster & more easily than you ever thought possible.

Drawing on the latest research in productivity science & Tracy’s decades of expertise, this breakthrough program allocates time into ten categories of priority—including strategic planning/goal setting, people & family, income improvement, rest/relaxation, & even creative time—and reveals the best techniques for focusing on each effectively. By thoughtfully applying the principles in Master Your Time, Master Your Life, you’ll not only achieve greater results & reach your goals more quickly & successfully, you’ll also have more time to devote to what you truly love.

There is a huge disconnect, Dr. Sonya explains, between how women are feeling in their minds & bodies & how they are treated in today’s medical system. They are told things like “it’s a part of aging,” “you just need to get out more,” or the best, “there’s nothing I can do but here’s an antidepressant.” Perimenopausal women in particular are told that the stage they are in doesn’t even exist, despite the multitude of symptoms they experience every single day. Women turn to influencers & Dr. Google to solve their health problems but don’t know how to navigate all the noise. They feel unheard, unsafe, undervalued, stretched to the max, & most of all, alone.

Until now. After treating patients in her Divine Elements Health Center for more than 15 years, conducting thousands of hormone tests & treatment protocols, leading women’s circles & yoga retreats, apprenticing with an OBGYN, studying the shamanic medicine wheel, & traveling a continuously evolving path of self-discovery, Dr. Sonya has identified the missing link in the realm of women’s health: how your everyday moments, emotions, & relationships are influenced by the health of your hormones.  

In this book, she unpacks this profound connection, then outlines her signature HER Method (Hormonal-Emotional-Relational) of healing, which includes:
• A breakdown of the hierarchy of hormonal healing • In-the-moment techniques to relieve suffering & deepen connection • Practices to bring you back in sync with your body, drawn from

A bedside journal for better sleep from a board-certified doctor, featuring proven, faith-informed tactics & soothing devotions for those who struggle with falling asleep.

Sleep Habits is a comforting companion from someone who understands your sleep frustrations & invites you on a journey toward better sleep & overall well-being. Board-certified sleep doctor Benjamin Long offers hope for anyone who needs help falling asleep or quieting the anxieties of the day while longing for rest. 

In addition to brief biblical devotions, this guided journal also features:
• Tips & simple exercises for getting a good night’s sleep
• Soothing & encouraging verses
• Prayers for sleep
• Habit trackers
• Questions & reflection prompts

Organised according to the Sleepless Night Rules, Sleep Habits Journal will equip you with practical tools inspired by CBT-I to improve your sleep quality. Whatever your nights look like, may this guided journal invite you into experiencing more peace, rest, & comfort.

Who has not experienced a dog who just won’t stop barking or a cat that seems to strike out without apparent reason? Relief might be at hand with the simple yet effective point-tapping practices of the Emotional Freedom Technique (EFT), which provide an excellent hands-on tool for treating behavioural, emotional, & health challenges in animals.

In this practical guide, expert animal communicator & healer Joan Ranquet shows how to apply this energetic bodywork method on animals such as dogs, cats, or horses. As you tap on certain acupressure points with a specific intention in mind, the animal will experience energetic release on the levels of mind, body, emotions, & spirit. For easy access, you will find maps clearly illustrating the specific EFT acupressure points on dogs, cats, & horses. In addition, Joan provides sample point sequences & intention scripts geared to specific ailments, conditions, & behavioural challenges, as well as end-of-life care. Targeted to work with & relieve difficult emotions, the points used in EFT sequences each have a feel-good aspect to them, either a calming or releasing effect, & the scripts work to help break up old behavioural or emotional patterning.

Presenting a way to cut straight to the energetic source of the problems the animal experiences & provide relief even if you don’t know the cause of their pain, this guide will help you not only become closer to your animal companions but also improve their well-being as well as your own.

We all want to be happier, but our brains often get in the way. When we’re too stuck in our heads, we obsess over our inadequacies, compare ourselves with others & fail to see the good in our lives.

In The Science of Happiness, world-leading psychologist & happiness expert Bruce Hood demonstrates that the key to happiness is not self-care but connection. He presents seven simple but life-changing lessons to break negative thought patterns & reconnect with the things that really matter.

• Alter Your Ego
• Avoid Isolation
• Reject Negative Comparisons
• Become More Optimistic
• Control Your Attention
• Connect With Others
• Get Out of Your Own Head

Grounded in decades of studies in neuroscience & developmental psychology, this book tells a radical new story about the roots of wellbeing & the obstacles that lie in our path. With clear, practical takeaways throughout, Professor Hood demonstrates how we can all harness the findings of this science to rewire our thinking & transform our lives.

• Shows the role water deficiency plays in a large number of diseases & other health disorders
• Explains how to determine the quality & quantity of water that is best for you & the time during the day it is best to drink
• Includes 10 water cures for profound physical rehydration, toxin removal, & remineralisation

Drinking sufficient quantities of water is a necessity for optimal physical functioning, but it can also play a major role in the prevention & treatment of many diseases. Chronic fatigue, depression, eczema, rheumatism, gastric disorders, high or low blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, & urinary infections are but a few of the many disorders that can result from not drinking enough water—and which can be treated by raising our intake of this vital liquid.

The physical assaults that our bodies endure from pollution, stress, overly rich & processed foods (often containing too much salt), & alcohol & tobacco have dramatically increased our daily need for water over what our ancestors required. Christopher Vasey explains not only why water is so essential to our health but also what quantities we should drink & when. He also discusses the qualities of different types of water & demonstrates which will best address certain conditions. In addition, he provides 10 water cures that will rehydrate the deepest levels of the body, remove toxins, & restore vital minerals.

हे दुकान खरोखरच विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी अत्यंत उपयुक्त आहे. इथे मराठी आणि इंग्रजी माध्यमासाठी इयत्ता 1 वी ते 12 वी पर्यंतच्या सर्व प्रकारच्या पाठ्यपुस्तकांची, नोटबुक्सची आणि वर्कबुक्सची संपूर्ण व्यवस्था आहे. शाळेची पुस्तके, कॉलेजची पुस्तके तसेच सर्व प्रकारची स्टेशनरी एकाच ठिकाणी सहज उपलब्ध होते.

दुकानात पुस्तकांची निवड भरपूर आहे आणि सर्व बोर्डांनुसार पुस्तके मिळतात. कर्मचार्‍यांचे वर्तनही खूप मदतीचे आणि सौजन्यपूर्ण आहे. विद्यार्थ्यांना आणि पालकांना आवश्यक असलेली सर्व शैक्षणिक साधने एकाच ठिकाणी मिळतात हे या दुकानाचे खरे वैशिष्ट्य.

अशा पुस्तक दुकानाची आपल्या परिसरात नक्कीच गरज होती. विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी हे एक उत्तम आणि विश्वासार्ह ठिकाण आहे.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Chadha
featured_reviews.review_text: They host wonderful events, but even more importantly, the staff are an absolute pleasure. I was looking for a book by a particular author and, after some disappointing experiences at another popular bookshop in Bandra, I was genuinely nervous about asking for help. At that other store (which rhymes with “confectionery”), the staff were often rude and surprisingly unfamiliar with many authors. When I cautiously approached the desk, the two gentlemen working there were incredibly kind, helpful, and immediately knew exactly who I was talking about. Their warmth and knowledge made all the difference. On top of that, they have a fantastic selection of books and authors. A truly lovely bookstore.

To know more  or want to explore the experience by yourself than please visit this Best place to purchase your next book.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimine BezBoznik Blesav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommended for non-fiction readers, researchers, thinkers, and anyone who enjoys meaningful reading beyond trends and algorithms.

Title Waves in Bandra has one of the finest collections across geopolitics, history, psychology, philosophy, business, biographies, and contemporary world affairs. The atmosphere is calm, intellectual, and welcoming for readers who still believe in the joy of physically browsing bookshelves.

A perfect place to disconnect from digital noise and reconnect with ideas, perspectives, and conversations that genuinely stimulate the mind.

featured_reviews.name: Architect on Trails
featured_reviews.review_text:
This cozy bookstore stands out for its unique selection. So many books I’ve never seen elsewhere! The vibe is just right for losing track of time among the shelves. There's also a café and a few seats next to the central podium.

A must-visit for anyone who loves books and cafés. Five stars for the variety!
